guide.adjust.accessories: Switching off the accessories block takes away every direct set for {groups}.
guide.adjust.easy: Everything feels easy? Add a little weight or a rep first; never jump ahead more than one week.
guide.adjust.edit: You (or your coach) can switch off a day's jumps, core or joint care, add or remove exercises (more rear-delt work, for example) and use the suggested supersets to save time.
guide.adjust.edit_blocks: You (or your coach) can switch off these blocks on any day: {blocks}. You can also add or remove exercises (more rear-delt work, for example).
guide.adjust.edit_none: You (or your coach) can add or remove exercises (more rear-delt work, for example).
guide.adjust.edit_stations: In a circuit you can skip the jump, throw or cardio station, or remove a small-muscle station: the rounds stay the same.
guide.adjust.edit_supersets: Use the suggested supersets to save time.
guide.adjust.life: Life got in the way for several weeks (sick, travel, busy)? Stop the block, take the recommended easy week if you want, then build a new block.
guide.adjust.max: A set felt like a true max (no rep left)? Next time take one set off that exercise, or a little weight.
guide.adjust.missed: Missed most of a week? Repeat that week before you move on. Missed one session? Do it on the next free day or let it go: never squeeze two sessions into one.
guide.adjust.pain: Something hurts? First use a listed swap, then cut that exercise's sets by a third to a half, then drop it for the rest of the block. See a professional if it keeps hurting.
guide.adjust.sets: You (or your coach) can also change the sets of any exercise on any day or week: the plan is a template.
guide.adjust.swim: Swimmers: keep the gym at least 4 hours away from a hard pool session when you can. After a hard pool week, switch off that day's jumps, remove an exercise or repeat the week. Before your main meet, taper the gym for 2 weeks in line with your swim coach's taper (1 week or none before smaller meets).
guide.adjust.time: The time shown on each day is an average estimate, for information only: nothing in this plan is cut or changed because of time. Want a shorter day? Use the suggested supersets, or remove what the day lists as easiest to remove.
guide.adjust.time_no_list: The time shown on each day is an average estimate, for information only: nothing in this plan is cut or changed because of time.

instruction.1: *Always leave 1 rep in the tank, never work up to failure but get as close as you can.
instruction.1_bridge: This plan starts at {start} in the tank and ends at {end} in the last week: the coach's "1 in the tank" is where you finish, so follow each week's number.
instruction.2: **Do steady cardio whenever you want, just don't overdo it... I recommend doing it on your aerobic days, max 40 min of steady.
instruction.2_bridge: In this plan your cardio sessions sit on lifting days: do each one as its own session that day, or move it to any free day.
instruction.2_bridge_optional: In this plan your cardio sits on your optional day ({days}): do it there, or on any other free day.
instruction.2_sport_cardio: **Do steady cardio whenever you want, just don't overdo it... Your sport practice already counts as your cardio; max 40 min of steady on top.
instruction.3: ***The lower the reps, the higher the weight... Always go for 1-3 RIR (reps in reserve), aka RPE 7+.
instruction.4: ****When there are joint pains, usually going unilateral and/or getting away from fixed grips (barbells, bars) and going to split grips (dumbbells, kettlebells, individual grips) helps take care of some stuff.
instruction.5: *****If you have any questions just ask me - IG @BLAZECAMP or TWITTER @BLAZECAMP_
instruction.cf.1: *Instead of working to failure, push your limits over the course of time.
instruction.cf.2: **CrossFit has its hybrid style of performance, so to be competitive, you MUST be able to be as good as possible in EACH modality. Train accordingly.
instruction.cf.3: ***WODs will be prescribed by your box or program; yes, they might interfere with recovery / performance, but that's part of CrossFit.
instruction.cf.3_class: ***The WODs in this plan are your conditioning on these days: do them in place of your box's WOD, not on top of it.
